All preconditions PASS read-only; each missing precondition returns its exact code with zero OAuth, key, session or order.

ABSTAIN or BLOCKED bridge results produce zero confirmation prompt, zero key prompt and zero canary.

Full IDs and Stage A digest shown; wrong phrase or suffix, extra text or EOF gives zero canary; nonexistent, wrong-hash, tampered, expired, scope-, host-, root- or menu-mismatched Stage A or permit/intent mismatch gives its code with zero canary; concurrent, sequential, root-substituted, same-path deleted or recreated ledger, EMPTY head, crash-restart and last-boundary ledger change allow at most one CREATE; offline bootstrap (missing parent and ledger) yields a non-empty head and check before Stage A is typed BLOCKED; receipts claim machine conformance only; conformant Stage A plus both suffixes gives one canary with identical objects and production defaults.

Receipt has no path, address, key, token or attestation; import does no I/O; banned terms, loops, retries, SELL absent; a seam without orchestrator_factory or an OFFLINE_TEST_ONLY handoff in production blocks with zero production orchestrator, signer prompt, account read or transmit.
